source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("e-commerce" OR "quick commerce" OR "on-demand economy" OR "dark stores" OR "online food delivery") AND (city OR cities OR urban) AND (freight OR logistics OR "spatial planning" OR planning OR establishments)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("e-commerce" OR "quick commerce" OR "on-demand economy" OR "dark stores" OR "online food delivery") AND (city OR cities OR urban) AND (freight OR logistics OR "spatial planning" OR planning OR establishments),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("dark stores" OR "on-demand economy" OR "online food delivery" OR "quick commerce" OR "e-commerce") AND ("spatial planning" OR "establishments" OR "freight" OR "logistics" OR "planning") AND ("cities" OR "city" OR "urban"))
